about: One list for both crisis checks: backend core/moderation.py (crisis_in) and frontend lib/aiSafety.ts (crisisIn). Tested by backend/tests/test_moderation.py and frontend/lib/aiSafety.test.mjs. 'care' must be caught; 'not_care' must not (figures of speech and hard days are for the checker, and they are fine).
